name: L2: cross-species transfer of a shared local plasticity rule
scope: Exploratory supervised offline direction decoding on real public macaque and human recordings; not physical/closed-loop control, reinforcement learning, neural mechanism conservation, or a new plasticity algorithm claim.
status: Implementation invariants passed; no L2 human scores inspected or generated.

outer_training.labels: MC_Maze goal sectors: [563,459,265,331,447,166,0,64]. Seven occupied classes (270deg absent), independently remapped into8output IDs each episode. No direction-specific weight carries. Area2/human have8classes, so this additionally tests7to8class generalisation.
outer_training.trials: 80% stratified training; 20% held out unused for fitting or selection
outer_training.optimiser: Adam .03, query crossentropy, outer gradient norm clipping5
outer_training.episode: fresh naive weights and feedback; channel subset24..96; k1/2/4/8 per class; 1or3 shuffled passes; up to8 disjoint query trials per class
outer_training.representation: source support-only CIS rise -100..+300ms; rawsqrt counts4x100ms means; withintrialcentring; globalcalibrationRMSnormscalar

source_selection.rule: 20fixed k2 one-pass support/query episodes; checkpoint0/100/200/300/400/500/600; maximise query accuracy, break ties by CE
source_selection.access: No Area2 meta-gradient; ALL rules use the same REAL Area2 validation episodes. Synthetic/time controls thus receive recorded-source information through shared checkpoint selection. They are not source-free. This is also a region/task shift.
source_selection.bp: Adam lr.001/.01/.03/.1, same validation episodes; maximise query accuracy then CE

inner_rule.network: direct plastic linear direction branch plus tanh32 hidden branch; direct readout class-row normalised; random fixed8to32feedback; zero direct/readout weights, fresh random hidden/feedback; no source weights/initialisation learned
inner_rule.coefficients: 9scalar coefficients: error/labelled-Hebbian/decay direct; random-feedback error/local Oja/decay hidden; error/labelled-Hebbian/decay hidden readout
inner_rule.signal: full class-labelled supervised teaching signal; NOT reward-only feedback
inner_rule.locality: No targetautograd inlocalarms. Ownweight/pre/post/teaching signal updates. Globalcalibration preprocessing, softmaxcompetition, perneuronweightnormalisation explicitly outside synapseupdate localityclaim.
inner_rule.prior: Adaptation of meta-learning local plasticity idea, not exact reproduction of Shervani-Tabar/Rosenbaum2023.

arms: synthetic cosine-Poisson full rule; source TRAIN-only per-bin/unit mean profile; no recorded trial trajectories
real source with each trial fourchunks shuffled AFTER common support-derived preprocessing; preserves time-averaged rates
real-source rate-only rule; error gains learned with same600episodes
real-source direct-only rule; no hidden learning
target-only conventional Adam BP; same architecture, init/order and feedback events
target-only labelled Hebbian correlation templateV; same target features; exact expressibility verified
source-free initial9coefficient rule; SAME exact manually set coefficients as sourcefitcheckpoint0

target.labels: 8-sector cued target direction, not observed hand movement
target.calibration: P1 SAVED IDs from data/wacv/xspecies_p1_draws_<session>_k<k>.npz,50draws at k1/2/4/8
target.primary: k2, onepass,16 unique labelled trials and16feedbackevents;3metaseeds; real>V and>synthetic and>timepermuted and>initial_rule inall3sessions. No transfer-learningattribution fromcheckpoint0.
target.primary_comparison: report paired per-draw deltas averaged across3meta seeds; percentile interval is calibration-split variability, not human population CI; endpoint point criterion + full ranges, no significance claim
target.secondary: k1/4/8;3passes at same unique-label budgets (3xfeedback events); compare BP/rate-only/direct-only; reference existing P1 results
target.preprocessing: CIS from targetcalibrationONLY. Rawsqrt-rate chunk features asP1V; withintrialcentring and onecalibration-derived globalnormscalar (preserves exact P1V). No perunitzscore. Identical finite-test inclusion toP1; directperdraw Vscore equality required.
target.states: Fully reset each target draw; same random hidden/feedback and sample order acrossallarms of a seed. Prototype receives the same labels; repeated presentations leave its predictor unchanged.
target.limits: Human test outcomes have already been examined by earlier X1/P1 methods. Whole project exploratory; no independent untouched human holdout. Neural decoded cursor is not independent kinematics. No brain plasticity recordings.
